name: performance/rectangle_list
description: The RectangleList tab of a live-data performance showcase. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore metric cards, telemetry, headings, tabs, buttons, controls, side panels, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent plot is visible with its axes and grid, spanning about 0 to 160 on x and 0 to 100 on y. Fail only if the axes, tick labels, or the plot area itself are cut off, or rectangles are drawn outside the plot area. Do not evaluate metric cards, telemetry, tabs, controls, side panels, or other content outside the plot.

A grid of translucent blue squares covers the plot. Square sizes vary smoothly across the plot in an organic plasma pattern: bright regions of large, overlapping squares alternate with darker regions of small squares, forming soft rounded blobs and bands. The plot is not blank and not one uniform solid block.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with metric cards, telemetry, headings, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
